stem: Which position did the political action group known as the Moral Majority support in the 1980s?

options.label: A
options.text: Students should be allowed to pray in public schools.

options.label: B
options.text: Society should welcome diverse family lifestyles.

options.label: C
options.text: Leaders should support the Equal Rights Amendment for women.

options.label: D
options.text: The Supreme Court should be encouraged to decide in favor of liberal ideas.
